paper_title: Mechanistic Understanding and Mitigation of Language Confusion in   English-Centric Large Language Models
caption: Distribution of Important Neurons Associated with Confusion Points in Llama3-8B. (a) Distribution of the top 300 most important FFN neurons across layers for an individual Chinese prompt “UTF8gbsn请解释拆东墙补西墙的意思。(Please explain `UTF8gbsn拆东墙补西墙.')” from Aya. (b) Aggregated distribution of important neuron scores across all Chinese test samples in Aya.

model_annotations.German: The two plots share the same x-axis, representing the layer, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 30 for the top plot and 0 to 35 for the bottom plot, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the count, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100 for the top plot and 0 to 175 for the bottom plot, and tick labels at intervals of 20 and 25, respectively. The top plot illustrates the distribution of the top 300 most important FFN value neurons across layers for an individual case, showing a blue line with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 5 at layer 0, remaining relatively stable until layer 15 with a count of approximately 6, and then increasing to around 90 at layer 28. The bottom plot shows the aggregated distribution of important neuron scores across all test samples, displaying a green line with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 10 at layer 15, remaining relatively stable until layer 28 with a count of around 10, and then sharply increasing to around 150 at layer 31.
